name: OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.iteration_accuracy
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma eps lower : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ) (R K : ℕ),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ sigma →
      0 < eps →
        (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
          (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
            (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), lower ≤ f x) →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g sigma →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), k < a k + R) →
                      8 * ↑R * L * (f x0 - lower) / eps + 16 * sigma ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / eps ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        1 / (↑K + 1) *
                            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
                              ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                                ‖gradient f
                                      (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g
                                        (LongTails.Setups.RingmasterIterations.stepSize L sigma eps R) a x0
                                        (fun i => ξ i ω) k)‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑P ≤
                          eps
